args.body: Use the committed payhip-help-seller-links.json to locate applicable first-party pricing and Canadian processor terms under the current mission. The earlier 403 applies to that retrieval. When terms support a fit, execute one existing package with verified redistribution rights from a clean directory and deliver the bilingual listing and activation handoff. Use comparable listings as asking-price evidence. If a decisive term fails or remains unresolved, record its effect on activation and the evidence that would reopen it. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, external contact, listing or spend.
